headline: Low interaction risk: no shared channels or write surfaces are documented, but A’s broad egress and B’s local-only profile leave limited uncertainty.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented between awesome-cli-apps and LightZero: A has no io_surfaces and B has no io_surfaces, use_mcp is false, and B cannot read files or run browsers. With no bridge, prompt injection via A into B is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, reassess injection risk.
IF B is modified to ingest A’s outputs automatically, the pathway becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared clipboard or workspace.
Do not pipe A’s text directly into B’s prompts.
Review any future orchestrator for provenance tagging.
requires-engineering: add explicit trust boundaries if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: A is documented with broad network egress, but B has network_egress none and cannot read_filesystem, so there is no documented path for B to receive or exfiltrate shared sensitive data. The pair lacks a shared workspace or data classes touched, so leakage is not supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is given access to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, reassess leakage risk.
IF B gains file-reading or outbound network capability, leakage pathways may appear.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
Leave B’s network egress disabled.
Avoid passing secrets in prompts to A.
requires-engineering: add DLP controls if shared storage is introduced.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: There is no overlapping write surface: B cannot write_filesystem or modify_git_state, and A has no documented filesystem or git write capability. Without a shared mutable resource, capability conflict between the pair is provably blocked by the profiles.
conditions: IF A is later granted filesystem or git write access, reassess for conflicts.
IF B is changed to write to the same directory as A, conflict risk increases.
mitigations: Keep B read-only.
Do not grant A write access to shared repos.
Use separate working directories.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared mutable state is introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: A is a content-writing/listing profile and B is a game-playing profile with no documented action-taking authority, so there is no evidence that B treats A’s output as authoritative or acts on it. With no shared input channel documented, cascading error is not supported.
conditions: IF B is wired to consume A’s outputs as instructions, reassess cascading error.
IF either agent gains downstream action authority, the pathway may emerge.
mitigations: Do not automate handoff from A to B.
Require human review before any downstream action.
Keep the agents in separate workflows.
requires-engineering: add verification gates before acting on generated text.

E_compliance.rationale: No compliance-sensitive data class, residency mismatch, or retention policy is documented for either agent. A’s docs-only profile and B’s docs-only profile provide no basis for a compliance breach between them, so the pathway is not evidenced.
conditions: IF either agent is assigned regulated data classes such as PHI or EU PII, reassess compliance.
IF residency or retention requirements are introduced, compare the two agents’ policies.
mitigations: Avoid routing regulated data through the pair.
Document data-class handling before deployment.
Review residency and retention requirements.
requires-engineering: implement policy checks if regulated data is added.
